cases.lesson: SQL built with user input is a high-confidence blocker in payments code.
cases.improvement: Keep this rule as a block candidate when evidence is directly in the diff.

cases.lesson: Documentation-only changes should use the fast route and avoid noisy findings.
cases.improvement: Keep docs-only routing separate from money and security review paths.

cases.lesson: A refund path that can approve more than the remaining refundable balance should block.
cases.improvement: Keep refunds on the strong model route and require direct balance evidence for blockers.
